subject: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps — Redwood vs Omnitek vs GenAI Labs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>, Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps — Redwood vs Omnitek vs GenAI Labs

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great discussion. Below is a concise recap and the proposed next steps so we have shared alignment heading into the bake-off week.

Quick recap of Acme's top priorities (as discussed):
- Latency at 95th percentile <= 180ms for 1-2k QPS production workload (primary)
- Deterministic cost per 1M tokens; ability to cap spend during the POC
- Data protection: in-flight encryption, SOC 2 evidence, and the option for VPC/private deployment
- Fine-grained routing for on-prem model fallback for sensitive workloads

Decision criteria you mentioned:
1) Performance (latency / throughput)
2) Quality parity on clinical summarization prompts (we'll evaluate with your 12 test prompts)
3) Operational visibility (token-level cost + traceability)
4) Security & compliance (SOC 2, data retention controls)
5) Total cost of ownership (inference + infra overhead)

What Redwood will deliver for the bake-off (proposed):
- A scorecard (attached: redwood-bakeoff-scoresheet.pdf) populated with objective metrics we'll measure across vendors
- Two test harnesses: (a) 95th-pctl latency at target throughput; (b) quality evaluation on your 12 clinical prompts with BLEU/ROUGE+human spot-check notes
- A lightweight deployment in a dedicated sandbox (hosted Dedicated mode) with a sample config (attached: sample-config.json)
- SOC 2 summary and link to our security pack (we'll share the full report under NDA)

Proposed timeline / next steps:
- Mon 2/23: we provision the sandbox and run baseline latency test (Redwood + Omnitek + GenAI Labs) — ~1-2 hours to run
- Tue 2/24: quality batch run using your 12 prompts; we'll share preliminary scores by EOD
- Wed 2/25: call to walk through the scorecard and open questions (30 min)

Immediate asks from Acme to help us prepare:
- Please confirm the list of 12 prompts you'll want scored (Samantha/Carlos)
- Confirm whether you want us to include exact tokenization parity tests or keep model variants as-is
- Point us to the procurement contact or timeline so we can surface any commercial docs ahead of time

Attachments: redwood-bakeoff-scoresheet.pdf, sample-config.json (stubs)

If that all looks good I'll schedule the sandbox provisioning and send a calendar invite for Wed 2/25.

Thanks — looking forward to running the tests.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps — Redwood vs Omnitek vs GenAI Labs

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the scorecard. A couple quick notes from our side:
- We'll confirm the 12 prompts by EOD today (Carlos is pulling the clinical set).
- For the POC, procurement wants to see SOC 2 evidence and a basic data retention policy. Can you share the SOC 2 attestation and a short summary of retention controls?
- We prefer tokenization parity (same tokenization & prompt engineering) for the quality run so differences are due to models, not preprocessing.

Procurement timeline: we're aiming to make a recommendation to the IT security committee the week of 3/9, so having the SOC 2 and a short commercial snapshot would be super helpful.

Also — can you confirm whether Redwood can limit egress or set a hard cap on monthly inference spend during the POC? That's a gating item for the budget owners.

Thanks,
Samantha
Lead Product Manager, Clinical AI | Acme Health
samantha.lee@acmehealth.com

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and answers to your asks below:

1) Prompts — please send the final 12 by EOD and we'll lock them for the quality run (tokenization parity is confirmed).
2) SOC 2 & retention — attaching a SOC 2 summary link (we will send full attestation under NDA). Summary: SOC 2 Type II, key controls for data encryption in transit & at rest, 90-day default retention for PII artifacts with configurable retention windows. We'll share the formal doc via secure link to Procurement.
3) Spend cap — yes, we can enforce a hard cap on inference spend for the POC at the account level. Proposed cap: $2,000 for the sandbox week; we can adjust if you need higher.
4) Timeline — we'll provision the sandbox now (Neha is on it). I've created the HubSpot deal record and attached the scorecard to the record: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/67890

I'll send the calendar invite for Wed 2/25 10:00 AM PT for the scorecard review. If Procurement wants the SOC 2 attestation earlier, please loop them and I'll escalate.

Thanks — talk soon.
